name: minimax-mcp-server
description: Connect Claude to the Minimax Slovenian accounting API (moj.minimax.si) to read and create organizations' customers, items, and invoices, and issue invoices with PDF output.
long_description:
A Model Context Protocol server for the Minimax Slovenian accounting/ERP API (moj.minimax.si).

**Read:**
- List organizations and organization details
- List customers and items
- List issued and received invoices (filter by year/status/customer)
- Look up VAT rates, currencies and countries
- Fetch report templates and analytics
- Read received-invoice attachments

**Create & act:**
- Create customers and items
- Create issued invoices (draft or issued) and received (supplier) invoices
- Issue an invoice and generate its PDF, plus other custom actions (credit note, cancellation, e-invoice)
- Upload received-invoice attachments
- New-resource IDs are returned directly from the Location header (no follow-up lookup needed)

**Authentication:**
- OAuth2 password grant against moj.minimax.si
- Client credentials (Developer ID + password) plus organization credentials
- Automatic token caching with refresh before expiry

A TypeScript port of the original Go `rac` server, packaged as a portable desktop extension.

prompts.name: create-invoice-workflow
prompts.description: Complete workflow to create, issue and generate a PDF for an invoice
prompts.text: Guide me through creating, issuing and generating a PDF for a Minimax invoice: 1) list_organizations, 2) fetch lookup data (get_vatrates, get_currency_by_code, get_country_by_code, get_report_templates), 3) create the item and customer, 4) create the issued invoice, 5) issue and generate the PDF, 6) extract the base64 PDF from the response.

prompts.name: revenue-summary
prompts.description: Summarise issued invoices for an organization and year with totals by customer and status
prompts.text: Summarise issued invoices for an organization (and optionally a year): 1) list_organizations to find the organisationId, 2) list_issued_invoices with pageSize 100 and page through all results, 3) sum InvoiceValue for the grand total and break it down by year, by customer and by PaymentStatus (Placan = paid), 4) present a compact table with totals and flag anything unpaid or overdue.

prompts.name: customer-invoice-history
prompts.description: Find a customer and list their issued invoices with a paid/unpaid breakdown
prompts.text: Show a customer's invoice history: 1) list_organizations to find the organisationId, 2) list_customers (page through) to find the customer and note its CustomerId, 3) list_issued_invoices (pageSize 100, all pages) keeping rows whose Customer.ID matches, 4) list them with date, number, amount and PaymentStatus and summarise total billed vs. outstanding.

prompts.name: recurring-monthly-invoice
prompts.description: Create and issue this month's recurring invoice for a customer, then generate the PDF
prompts.text: Create and issue this month's recurring invoice: 1) list_organizations, 2) list_customers for the customer, 3) list_items for the item, get_vatrates (code 'S' = 22%) and get_report_templates (IR), 4) create_issued_invoice with Customer, DateIssued today, due date ~14 days out, Currency EUR, PricesOnInvoice 'N', Status 'O', the IR report template and one IssuedInvoiceRow (ItemName, Quantity, Price, VatRate 22%); note the Created ID and RowVersion, 5) confirm with me, then perform_issued_invoice_action with actionName 'issueAndGeneratepdf' and the RowVersion to issue it and return the PDF.

prompts.name: enter-received-invoice
prompts.description: Record a supplier (received) invoice against an existing supplier
prompts.text: Record a received (supplier) invoice: 1) list_organizations, 2) list_customers for the supplier (create_customer if it does not exist), 3) create_received_invoice with Customer, DateIssued, DateReceived, DateDue, Currency EUR, InvoiceAmount, DocumentReference (supplier's number) and Status 'O' (draft) or 'P' (confirmed), 4) report the Created ID and confirm.

prompts.name: unpaid-invoices
prompts.description: List unpaid and overdue issued invoices for an organization
prompts.text: List unpaid and overdue issued invoices: 1) list_organizations, 2) list_issued_invoices (pageSize 100, all pages), 3) keep rows whose PaymentStatus starts with 'Neplacan' (unpaid) or 'DelnoPlacan' (partially paid) and flag '...Zapadel' as overdue, 4) show them sorted by due date with customer, amount, due date and days overdue, plus the total outstanding.
